asunder: Part of the distance they rode in the car, and after disembarking, passed the Pontellier mansion, which looked broken and half torn asunder.
Entering at that moment, he was an incorporation of the strongest reasons through which Will’s pride became a repellent force, keeping him asunder from Dorothea.

I strung you on!  Would God--O God, my mind
Stretches asunder on this merciless rack
Of imagery!  O, let me sleep a while!
He would look for her, he would find her out before the evening were over, and at present, perhaps, it was as well to be asunder.

At any moment we may be hurled
Asunder.  They follow their orbits, we
Obey their laws entirely.
Thy sword is with me to cut asunder my bonds, and there shall be no fear left for me in the world.
